positive.prompt: Build a DCF for an NSE-listed manufacturer. What tax rate goes into NOPAT?
Which risk-free rate should I use in the WACC for an Indian company?
Compare EV/EBITDA across listed Indian retailers, some of which lease most of their stores.
Can I value an Indian private bank with an FCFF DCF?

negative.prompt: How is LTCG on my listed Infosys shares taxed after 2 years?
What brokerage, STT and stamp duty will I pay buying ₹2 lakh of Reliance shares?

evals.prompt: What tax rate should the terminal-year NOPAT use for an Indian company that has opted into the concessional 22% corporate tax regime?
expectations: Use the statutory regime rate, not the historical effective rate

evals.prompt: Which 10-year rate should I use as the risk-free rate for an INR DCF, and what should I record with it?
expectations: FBIL 10-year G-Sec benchmark, with its as-of date and benchmark security; never a number from memory

evals.prompt: Can I use the US 10-year Treasury yield plus a US equity risk premium to discount INR cash flows of a Nifty company?
expectations: No: currency mismatch; use INR rf + INR ERP, or USD inputs with an inflation-differential adjustment

evals.prompt: Run an FCFF DCF and EV/EBITDA comps on HDFC Bank.
expectations: Do not use FCFF or EV/EBITDA on banks; use P/B vs RoE (justified P/B), residual income

evals.prompt: In my fundamentals backtest I use October–December quarter results from 31 December onward. Okay?
expectations: No: usable only from disclosure date; LODR allows 45 days for quarterly results, so 31 Dec data is not visible on 15 Jan

evals.prompt: I'm plotting EV/EBITDA for an Indian retailer from FY2016 to FY2025. Anything to adjust?
expectations: Ind AS 116 from 1 Apr 2019 raises EBITDA; break the series or restate, and put lease liabilities in net debt consistently
